description: Source code for the AndroidFinalPackageElement class, which manages packaging elements related to Android final APK packaging within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidFinalPackageElement
classes.description: Represents a packaging element for the final Android APK, managing its associated facet and packaging instructions.

classes.name: AndroidFinalPackageElementState
classes.description: Serializable state class for AndroidFinalPackageElement, storing the facet pointer ID.

methods.name: AndroidFinalPackageElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packaging element with project and optional Android facet.

methods.name: createPresentation
methods.description: Creates a visual presentation for the packaging element in the artifact editor.

methods.name: getApkPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the APK file associated with the Android facet, appending a suffix and converting to system-independent format.

methods.name: computeAntInstructions
methods.description: Generates Ant build instructions for extracting the APK directory.

methods.name: computeIncrementalCompilerInstructions
methods.description: Provides instructions for incremental compilation, copying the APK directory if valid.

methods.name: getFacet
methods.description: Returns the associated AndroidFacet, if available.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks equality with another packaging element based on the facet pointer.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serializes the current state, including the facet pointer ID.

methods.name: findFacet
methods.description: Finds the AndroidFacet in the given context.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads the element state from serialized data, restoring the facet pointer.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the facet.

methods.name: findModule
methods.description: Finds the module associated with the Android facet.

methods.name: getSourceRoots
methods.description: Returns an empty list, as source roots are not applicable.
